purpose: Adjudicate the retained OECD non-consolidated Romania stock/transaction reference boundary against an independent official ECB national-QFA internal-consistency tolerance, instrument by instrument, without changing Accounting Spine readiness or behavioural state.

official_rule.source: Euro area quarterly financial accounts — 2013 quality report
official_rule.section: 3.4.1 Internal consistency: horizontal consistency by financial instrument
exact_scope: Internal consistency covers national accounting identities and hierarchical relationships.
Horizontal consistency is equality between the sum of financial assets and the sum of liabilities for each financial instrument.
The quality-report footnote states that discrepancies below EUR 10 million are acceptable in national data.

later_continuity_sources.title: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts — Quality report 2020
later_continuity_sources.point: Internal consistency remains an explicit accounting-validation quality dimension; Romania is among countries with minor exceptions.

later_continuity_sources.title: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts — Quality report 2022
later_continuity_sources.point: Internal consistency remains an explicit validation-rule dimension and Romania remains a minor-exception case.

later_continuity_sources.title: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts — Quality report 2024
later_continuity_sources.point: The current quality framework continues to assess national QFA internal consistency and accounting validation rules.

legal_context.point: Quarterly national financial accounts are based on Union statistical standards and are subject to ECB reporting/quality requirements.

non_euro_application_context.note: Romania is explicitly covered in the non-euro EU validation table; the validation framework is therefore relevant to Romanian national QFA.

retained_source_boundary.semantic_structural_zero: S1M/L/F2 only, preregistered from ESA 2010 before value review

exact_decimal_instrument_audit.method: From the already-retained exact source rows, sum assets minus liabilities across S1M+S11+S12+S13+S2 separately for each F2-F8 instrument and each stock/flow quarter using exact base-10 arithmetic. S121 cancels algebraically between F=S12-S121 and BNR=S121.

currency_unit_adjudication.conservative_conclusion: The maximum 0.2 million RON discrepancy is far below EUR 10 million under official observed EUR/RON scales; exact quarter-specific FX conversion cannot affect the pass/fail classification.
